scope: Offline observation contract. Current conformance is not historical model compatibility or quality approval.
reference_provenance: Same model bytes at original repository commit; exact original training execution not independently proven.

hash_scopes.sources_and_contract: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF normalized to LF

feature_definitions.packet_rate: Sum observed packets divided by 10 seconds, global, causal.
feature_definitions.byte_rate: Sum observed bytes divided by 10 seconds, global, causal.
feature_definitions.source_entropy: Shannon base-2 entropy of per-source observation/event counts, not packet-weighted counts.
feature_definitions.syn_fraction: SYN-bearing event count divided by source event count in exact inclusive recent 10-second source history; distinct from target packet-count rules.
feature_definitions.iat_mean: Mean seconds between consecutive same-source/destination/service events in retained source history; zero without an interval.
feature_definitions.iat_cv: Population interval CV, denominator max(mean,1e-9); zero for fewer than two intervals.
feature_definitions.destination_count: Unique destination IP count in inclusive recent 10-second source history.
feature_definitions.port_count: Unique destination port count in inclusive recent 10-second source history.
feature_definitions.domain_entropy: Shannon base-2 character entropy of first DNS label, lowercase, trailing dot removed; zero if absent.
feature_definitions.domain_length: Length of full normalized DNS name, including dots; zero if absent.
feature_definitions.domain_digit_ratio: First-label digit count divided by max(1,label length).
feature_definitions.bigram_surprise: First-label adjacent pairs absent from fixed COMMON_BIGRAMS set divided by max(1,pair count).
feature_definitions.txt_record: One iff DNS type is 10(NULL) or 16(TXT) and name exists; legacy feature name retained.
feature_definitions.encrypted: Float of event.encrypted; supplied/parsed metadata, no decryption.
feature_definitions.size_cv: Population CV of bytes/packets per same-peer event in retained history; not total-byte CV.
feature_definitions.egress_bytes: Sum bytes of retained source history: inclusive 60 seconds and max 512 events. Uncapped rule/evidence byte feature is separate.
feature_definitions.byte_ratio: Numeric ML ratio: zero when reverse unavailable, otherwise definition-specific; observed ratio kept separately.
feature_definitions.reverse_available: Float of explicitly observed reverse metadata flag; no inferred reverse traffic.
feature_definitions.fingerprint_risk: One iff a retained same-peer event exactly matches the fixed synthetic lab fingerprint; known shortcut.
feature_definitions.history_count: Count same-source/destination/service events in retained history, including current observation.

historical_definitions.global_rate_window: Exact inclusive event-time lookback of 10 seconds; capped by 4096 global events; divide by 10.
historical_definitions.source_entropy_window: Same capped global history, exact source identities, observation-weighted.
historical_definitions.byte_ratio_observed_zero: bytes / max(1, reverse_bytes or 0) when reverse observed; numeric zero when unavailable.

current_definitions.global_rate_window: Inclusive floor(timestamp/1000) bucket seconds from current_second-10 through current_second; divide by 10; oldest partial second retained; packet/byte totals uncapped by event history.
current_definitions.source_entropy_window: Same global buckets, observation-weighted; 4096 exact identities plus overflow group; partial/lower-bound flag disclosed.
current_definitions.byte_ratio_observed_zero: Observed ratio null when reverse bytes are zero; numeric ML zero; availability remains 1.

shared_history: 512 events per source, inclusive 60 seconds, LRU 4096 sources; peer is destination address and port; strictly earlier-than-watermark events dropped; equal timestamps accepted.
limitations: Finite probes and source pins do not prove general semantic equivalence or accuracy.
Global entropy depends on event granularity; packet and flow-summary inputs are not equivalent.
Legacy egress_bytes is bounded and is distinct from uncapped rule evidence.
Synthetic fingerprint and reverse availability are shortcut signals.
Known historical incompatibility remains unresolved; do not auto-fit or auto-activate.
